tasks.gr8-media-literary-texts-t2: Topic: Media and literary texts. Cover news reports, articles, folklore, and drama with focus on plot, character, conflict, theme, and how information is shaped across genres. Ask Grade 8 learners to distinguish fact and opinion, analyse headline technique, compare text purposes, and interpret conflict and theme using evidence.
tasks.gr8-formal-correspondence-reviews-t2: Topic: Formal correspondence and reviews. Cover formal and informal letters, email conventions, review writing, register control, and audience-purpose matching. Ask Grade 8 learners to choose correct formats, apply suitable tone, identify structural conventions, and justify review judgements with relevant examples.
tasks.gr8-language-report-dialogue-t2: Topic: Language for report and dialogue. Cover perfect and future tenses, conjunction use, direct and indirect speech, and active-passive voice choices. Ask Grade 8 learners to convert speech accurately, maintain tense sequence, link clauses logically, and edit language structures in context.
